description: Resolve up to 3 comma-separated product permalink IDs into cached listings for comparison. Each listing includes url, marketplace and item_id, plus title, price and condition when available. Unresolvable IDs and IDs beyond the limit are omitted; an empty set returns listings: []. Cache-only.

ids.description: Up to 3 product permalink ids in ONE comma-separated string, e.g. amazon~~B0G2BFZRGL,v1~158082631449~0 — ids from /api/public/products or /api/public/search (MCP tools lianex_products, lianex_search). Extra ids are ignored.

name: lianex_resolve_compare
title: Resolve permalink ids to comparable listings
